integrity: The result uses the published harmonic-triple face-poset theorem as an explicit premise; no independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies local vertex degree and simple vertices, not the complete one-skeleton or a closed full degree distribution.
The finite exhaustive checker covers \(n=2,\ldots,8\); the all-\(n\) statement rests on the written combinatorial proof.
title: Simple vertices and local degree of the harmonic polytope
